title: Beneficiary/distribution outreach + pilot acceptance-path
context: open-data-explainers measures success as adoption by a named beneficiary, not as explainers produced. An explainer with no adopting partner counts as delivered-pending, not shipped. M0 requires a realistic acceptance path for the pilot before building begins: either a named informal channel (a teacher, extension office, newsroom, or portal who has agreed to evaluate the pilot) or a documented self-serve fallback (publish to the project site and pursue at least one external link or use). This outreach task opens the threads and documents the path.
objective: Open at least one beneficiary outreach thread and document a pilot acceptance path — either a named informal channel or a documented self-serve fallback — before the M0 pilot (pilot-008) begins construction.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 1 outreach thread opened with a named candidate beneficiary (school/OER network, local newsroom, civic group, extension office, or civic portal) for the county-ag pilot explainer.

A documented pilot acceptance path is committed: either (a) an informal channel with a named contact who has agreed to evaluate the pilot, or (b) a self-serve fallback plan specifying where the explainer will be published and how at least one external link or use will be pursued.
Outreach notes recorded in a committed document with channel, contact (anonymised where appropriate), and current response status.
At least one thread remains open and is tracked through to acceptance, delivered-pending determination, or confirmed self-serve+external-use.
resources: PLAN.md — Roadmap M0 cold-start de-risking section
output: A committed outreach-notes document (e.g. OUTREACH.md) recording at least one open thread, the named contact or self-serve fallback plan, and the current acceptance-path status.
